lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Investigation or close reading: defining variables and assumptions

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows the kind of reasoning the investigation asks for.

items.prompt: A quantity increases by 4 each hour. Select a model type.

steps: Define the relevant quantities and assumptions.
State a conclusion with its limitation or evidence.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Talk through what changes and what stays fixed before you answer.

items.prompt: A model gives 5x + 1 = 36. What is x?
Two constraints are y = 4x + 2 and y = 6x - 12. What is their shared solution?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A rectangular design has side lengths 8 units and 15 units. What is its diagonal?
In a data set, hours of screen time increase and hours of sleep generally decrease. What association is shown?
A line of fit was made from data for temperatures 40° through 80°. It is used to predict a temperature at 120°. Which limitation is most important?
choices: The prediction is an extrapolation and may be less reliable.
The data range no longer matters.
The prediction must be exactly correct.

items.prompt: Which action provides the strongest evidence that a model fits a situation?
choices: show calculations and compare predictions to data

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Write out the reasoning in full sentences. A correct answer with no justification does not count here.

items.prompt: Which conclusion communicates a mathematical model responsibly?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A moving company charges by the number of hours worked. Which definition of x best models this situation?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
